brand.logoPrompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: finished horizontal website logo for an independent veterinarian brand called PolotskVet, serving Polotsk and Novopolotsk, Belarus. Create ONE polished logo lockup on a genuinely transparent alpha background, with a compact red emblem on the left and the exact wordmark "PolotskVet" on the right. Text must be exactly PolotskVet, capital P and V, all other letters lowercase, no spaces and no other writing. Emblem: a simple friendly paw incorporating a heart-shaped main paw pad and four softly rounded toe pads, unified and well balanced; warm and caring but professional, immediately readable at a small header size. Color: emblem a rich warm red #cf3044, wordmark deep dark navy #142438. Custom refined rounded sans-serif lettering, medium-bold, clear open counters, very legible; warm personality without cartoon styling. Proportions: emblem about the height of the wordmark capitals plus a small margin; generous clear gap between emblem and wordmark; horizontal arrangement about 4:1; tightly compose the logo with modest even transparent margins, never crop any part. Style: flat vector-like graphic rendered as a clean high-resolution PNG, smooth precise edges, restrained and timeless. No medical cross, no stethoscope, no bag, no pet faces, no tagline, no location subtitle, no extra icons, no circular badge, no background tile, no border, no gradients, no 3D, no shadows, no glow, no mockup, no watermark. This must look like a ready-to-use small veterinary practice identity, cute enough to communicate kindness and serious enough for a doctor.
brand.markPrompt: Faithful extraction of the approved logo's red paw-heart emblem on a square transparent PNG. Preserve four toes, heart pad and red color, remove wordmark.
